regional_summary_6h.headline: MENA Index 2.31 (STABLE): Iran Drives Regional Tensions

bullets.text: Iran's ongoing military conflict with the US is driving regional instability, with rising oil prices and widening inequality in Africa
Iran's alleged drone strike on a US base in Kuwait has escalated tensions, prompting concerns about the spread of conflict in the region
The Iran war is also having economic implications, with ExxonMobil and Chevron's profits surging due to rising oil prices, while Europe struggles with low gas reserves
